messages:
Alex Chen: Quick async handover — current state and next steps.

Alex Chen: What I did: rotated grpc-proxy pods in us-west, scaled inference-pool-small by +50, pushed a rollback for the proxy canary.

Alex Chen: Blockers: still seeing ~2-3% 503 for long-poll requests, suspect sticky LB session causing backend mismatch. Need neteng to check target group TTLs and affinitized session behavior.

Maria V: I followed traces for the 503s — errors look like proxy->router gRPC deadline exceeded. I pushed a temporary route to fallback-quant-v1 for the affected client, monitoring now.

Sam B: Taking billing-queue incident. consumer-processor-3 stuck on message id 8421, retries piling. Restarting the consumer pod and will inspect poison-message handling.

Lee N: PR up for health-check watchdog that will evict unhealthy nodes earlier: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789 — quick review appreciated :eyes:

Jordan P: Heads up — acme-co flagged quality drop after fallback to smaller model. CS looped in. If fallback persists >5m we should escalate to product/SRE for SLA notes.

ops-bot: ALERT: grpc-proxy (us-west-2) 5xx spike detected — 1200 events in last 5m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/12345

Alex Chen: Next steps: neteng ticket (+Maria), let Sam finish billing restart, Lee to merge PR if CI green. I'll keep watching p50/p95 and logs, then pass to night team @Sam B @Lee N. Passing to night team @here :wave:

Maria V: Monitoring — error rate dropped to ~0.8% after the route change :thumbsup: still watching traces for regressions.

Sam B: consumer restarted; backlog draining (450 -> 80). Investigating for poison messages; will quarantine if found.

Lee N: CI green, merging PR now.

Alex Chen: Operational shortcut if 5xx climbs again — switch traffic to hosted-fallback region us-east-1: 
```
./scripts/switch-region.sh us-east-1 --service grpc-proxy
```

Alex Chen: Handing off. Please ping in thread for any updates. End of handover.
